A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the extreme water levels, defined as the combination of tide, wave runup and storm surge, play a key role in dune erosion and sediment budget, especially in the case of high-energy macrotides.
dune erosion is a function of the interaction between extreme water levels and the beach slope.
dune morphological variations on this high-energy macrotidial beach are controlled by extreme water levels and storm conditions.

extreme water levels and dune erosion are highly correlated.
